content: Firebase docs (firestore/query-data/listen#detach_a_listener) require detaching listeners via the unsubscribe function returned by onSnapshot. React docs (react.dev/reference/react/useEffect + synchronizing-with-effects) state StrictMode runs an extra setup+cleanup cycle in development and that the rule of thumb is the user must not be able to distinguish one setup from setup->cleanup->setup; the fix is a real cleanup function, not disabling StrictMode. Classic failure: useEffect(() => { onSnapshot(...) }) with no dependency array and no returned unsubscribe causes an out-of-memory crash ('React is out of memory' on StackOverflow 73342659) and ever-growing billed reads (50 the first time, 100 the second, 200 the third) as listeners stack up (SO 65659438).
